title: SREV-051 DNS filter CSADDR_INFO alignment contract

lpcsaBuffer.description: WSAQUERYSETW pointer to packed CSADDR_INFO array

alignment.description: Pointer-size alignment used before packing pointer-bearing structures

contracts: WSAQUERYSETW.lpcsaBuffer points to a CSADDR_INFO array
The packed buffer cursor must be aligned to sizeof(void*) before assigning lpcsaBuffer
The required-size formula must include the same CSADDR_INFO alignment padding
Runtime cursor alignment and size calculation alignment must use one schema
